title: Thermally stable network-structured polysiloxane hybrimers with high refractive index for optical applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2384-2392
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07228J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kyungkuk Koh, Seongjin Kim, Honglae Sohn
Network-structured polysiloxane hybrimers deliver high-index clarity: NPH 3 reaches n = 1.61 (450 nm) with 96.5% transmittance and retains 96.0% after 200 °C/72 h, providing a durable route to low-loss encapsulants.
